instruction_hash_definition: SHA256 of original instruction UTF-8 bytes; no normalization
ordered_digest_serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma, colon), no newline: ordered IDs as [row_id,...]; ordered group assignments as [[row_id,semantic_group_id],...], in preserved row order.
analysis_group_order: First appearance of semantic_group_id in retained manifest order; pair and resample groups in that fixed order.
analysis_group_rule: Both final Wi-Fi setup variants share harmless_test.json:5238; every other retained row is a singleton named by row_id. Fixed assignments do not prove statistical independence.
